requisito: Returns the maximum value in a non-empty list of integers.

difetti.indizio: Look at how max is initialized before the loop.
difetti.spiegazione: Initializing max to 0 only works when the list contains at least one non-negative number: with only negative numbers, no element exceeds 0 and 0 is returned.

difetti.indizio: Look at the if condition inside the loop.
difetti.spiegazione: The condition numeri[i] < max updates max whenever a smaller value is found, computing the minimum instead of the maximum.
